newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Seylan Bank up 2.1 pct on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Seylan Bank up 2.1 pct on bargain hunting.

text.p: Buying by retail investors pushed up share prices of Seylan Bank Ltd by 2.1 percent, or 50 cents to 24.50 rupees, in early Wednesday trading, brokers said.
"Liquid, cheap stocks in the finance sector are favoured by retailers becaue they yield short-term gains when the market is firming," said a broker serving retail investors.
The all share index on the Colombo bourse, which closed 4.59 points higher at 585.29 on Tuesday, has slowly risen in the past two weeks. It has gained by more than three percent.
Early trade volume for Seylan Bank was 17,000 shares, brokers said.
